title: cdfh-followup: slot-conflict responses must be 4.09 Conflict (currently 2.05) + reconcile 3 test expectations
description: Refinement of cdfh's response-code ask (spec/08:226-236 GCP-6.5 step 11: an unresolved slot conflict responds 4.09 Conflict carrying the WINNING gateway's claim as payload). Current state at HEAD: resources.rs handle_post_slots' conflict arm returns CoapResponse::content(reject_map, CBOR) = 2.05 Content with the rejection map — the 4.03 arms (expired/replay/invalid-slot) are correct, but the CONFLICT response code is 2.05 not 4.09. IMPLEMENTATION ATTEMPTED by worker-1 (reverted): changed the conflict arm to 0x93 with the winning-claim payload (already built: conflict_cose) — this broke 3 tests asserting 0x45: fully_occupied (its path is insufficient_free_slots -> 2.05 is the in-tree contract, NOT a conflict), slot_state_write_failure (retry expects 0x45 — its retry path hit 4.09 for a reason needing investigation), rejected_conflicting_claim (conflict -> 4.09 correct). PRECISE REMAINING WORK: (1) conflict arm -> 0x93 + winning-claim payload (the arm exists, only the code constant needs changing from 0x45 to 0x93); (2) fully_occupied's insufficient_free_slots response stays 2.05 (its own contract); (3) slot_state_write_failure's retry: investigate why the retry returns 4.09 (its claim [40] vs owned [0..30] has no overlap — the 4.09 must come from a different arm — trace before changing the expectation); (4) update the 2 stale 0x45 assertions to 0x93 where the path is the conflict arm. All changes are in resources.rs handle_post_slots + its tests; the handler's silent-discard and 4.03 arms are correct and must not change.
close_reason: Already landed at HEAD by 63715aa4f0 (which corrected b6f5d79741's wrong 0x93 constant to the real 4.09=0x89): win-arm returns CoapResponse::conflict (resources.rs:1979, constructor :1031-1037), the 3 named conflict tests assert 0x89 (resources.rs:2750/2951/2995), fully_occupied insufficient_free_slots stays 2.05 (:2826), silent-discard/4.03 arms untouched. Verified: 252 lib tests pass + 1 ignored (reviewer's 253 count = ignored test); end_to_end RED is runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim, deliberately RED per human bead ljgs. Item (3) slot_state_write_failure retry trace: retry now correctly lands on 4.09 conflict path, test asserts 0x89 at :2951. 1 reviewer pass (kimi-k3 correctness): PASS, no defects; passes 2-3 of 3x protocol not run since this round produced zero code changes (verification-only close), noted here per protocol. Residual spec step-11 payload divergence (rejection map vs winning gateway's claim) filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-3mz9 - structural, outside this bead's declared scope.
